cardDescriptor: A bag, a ritual, and a question about daily objects.
panelDescription: A containment vessel designed for identity fragments and lost memories. The interior volume is non-linear, allowing for the storage of items larger than the bag itself, provided they are sufficiently abstract.

copyrightWard.title: Non-Euclidean Custody
copyrightWard.warning: The object may be carried. Its characters, memories, and interior dimensions remain in the custody of Q888.
